Maria CSM: FYI — Preflight with Debbie's team tomorrow 9am PT. Need to confirm which SLA commitments we can promise and the credit scenarios if latency spikes. Customer is in procurement loop; renewal flagged if we can't give clarity.

AJ (Eng Ops): Can you confirm expected traffic profile? p95 latency target they're asking for is 150ms for embeddings path.

Maria CSM: Traffic ~350 reqs/min peak, mostly embeddings and short-gen, bursty at top of hour. We currently advertise 99.9% uptime for hosted, with latency SLOs per-model. @Samir any constraints on offering 150ms p95?

Samir - Solutions: 150ms p95 is tight on hosted for their model size (7B dense). We can propose two paths: Dedicated reserved capacity (guaranteed padding) or Hosted with a 'latency guardrail' and credits if p95 > 150ms for >1hr window. For hosted credits: sliding scale 1% monthly credit for every 0.5% uptime below SLA, plus latency credit bucket (see example).

Debbie (Customer): procurement asked for a clear example of how credits would be calculated. they need a deterministic formula.

Maria CSM: I'll draft examples. Quick ask — do we have a short calc snippet we can paste?

SLOBot: Generated SLO snapshot for account debbie_co — uptime 99.92% (lookback 30d), p95 latency 220ms (embeddings), recent incident on 3167800000 caused 0.03% outage.

Samir - Solutions: Paste this for transparency: ```json
{"SLA_uptime":99.9,"observed_uptime":99.92,"credit_rate_per_uptime_drop":"1% per 0.5% below SLA","latency_p95_target_ms":150,"observed_latency_p95_ms":220,"latency_credit":"0.5% per 50ms over target per day capped at 10%"}
``` Keep in mind the latency credits stack with uptime credits but capped.

AJ (Eng Ops): Ops note — for Hosted we can set a monitoring guard that triggers automatic escalation and a temporary burst allocation for 30m. That reduces chance of prolonged >1hr windows. Will need enablement to confirm runbook.

Maria CSM: Action items: (1) I draft 2 contract paths (Dedicated vs Hosted w/credits) + example calc, (2) @Samir to sanity-check credit caps, (3) @AJ to confirm auto-burst feasibility and runbook, (4) Debbie to confirm procurement timeline. I'll send draft by EOD.

Debbie (Customer): Procurement needs paper by Friday COB. They also want a one-page example walk-through for finance.

Samir - Solutions: I can provide the one-pager with a worked example: monthly usage 10M embedding tokens, observed p95 jump to 300ms for 2 days => compute latency credit X. I'll add a small table.

Maria CSM: Perfect. Tagging this as renewal-risk-watch. Quick question: do we want to include a 'warmstart' clause (proactive cache warming) as a mitigator in the contract?

AJ (Eng Ops): Yes — warmstart is feasible for Dedicated; for Hosted we can offer shared warmup orchestration as part of onboarding playbook (no extra cost first 30 days).

Debbie (Customer): That helps. If it's in writing, procurement will be happier.

Maria CSM: Cool. I'll circulate draft + SLO calc + one-pager. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

SLOBot: Note added to account: 'preflight commitments doc sent by Maria 3167891400'
